ei.title: The Value of Play for Entrepreneurs

fullPassage: Easier said than done, but time away and time for play is invaluable to the busy entrepreneur. If you think that's frivolous, you need to change your mindset or face the consequences down the road. There's an epidemic of burnout in entrepreneur culture, and it stems from the always-on, always-plugged-in, always-working nature of work today. True, some of this is par for the course when you're starting a business. But whatever time you can pull away to let your mind rest and play will pay back in both productivity and creativity. Don't believe me? Even Albert Einstein espoused the benefits of play. When he was stuck on a certain problem, instead of powering through, he would take time away to play his violin. He attributed some of his biggest breakthroughs to this practice.

questions.passage: Easier said than done, but time away and time for play is invaluable to the busy entrepreneur. If you think that's frivolous, you need to change your mindset or face the consequences down the road. There's an epidemic of burnout in entrepreneur culture, and it stems from the always-on, always-plugged-in, always-working nature of work today. True, some of this is par for the course when you're starting a business. But whatever time you can pull away to let your mind rest and play will pay back in both productivity and creativity. Don't believe me? Even Albert Einstein espoused the benefits of play. When he was stuck on a certain problem, instead of powering through, he would take time away to play his violin. He attributed some of his biggest breakthroughs to this practice.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 바쁜 기업가도 쉬고 놀아야 생산성과 창의성이 높아진다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 기업가의 재무 관리 전략 — 본문 주제 아님.
✅ ② 기업가에게 휴식과 놀이가 생산성·창의성에 미치는 긍정적 효과 — 전체 핵심.
❌ ③ 아인슈타인의 과학적 업적 목록 — 아인슈타인은 예시.
❌ ④ 기업 문화에서의 위계질서 — 본문에 없음.
det.tip: 핵심어: time away, play, invaluable, productivity, creativity, breakthroughs

ch: 기업가에게 휴식과 놀이가 생산성·창의성에 미치는 긍정적 효과

questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

❌ ③ 기업가는 쉬지 않고 일해야 성공한다 — 글 주장과 정반대.
✅ ④ 바쁜 기업가도 놀이와 휴식 시간을 확보하면 생산성과 창의성이 향상된다 — 전체 요지.
det.tip: 요지: 놀이·휴식 → 생산성+창의성 향상 → 번아웃 예방
